Homestead Assemblage, LLC to make a presentation to the Board for the development of property identified as Block 7905, Lots 20, 21, 22 and 23, commonly known as 618 Pavonia Avenue, 616 Pavonia Avenue and 33- 35 Van Reipen Avenue (“Phase 4 Property”), Block 7902, Lots 46, 47, 48 and 49, commonly known as 32-38 Cottage Street (“Phase 5 Property”), and Block 7904, Lots 1 and 2, commonly known as 29 Van Reipen Avenue (“Phase 6 Property”), to develop and construct Phases 4, 5 and 6 of their Project.
